TEC Rewards Distribution - round-27 - 16/01/23 to 29/01/23

This period covers praise given between 16 January 2023 and 29 January 2023. We allocated 27.35749902.0 TEC tokens for rewards, using our new distribution system which boosts non-paid contributors. Some praise accounts still haven’t been activated so the total amount below will be less than what we set aside to distribute.

Out of the total rewards:

  • 90% of the tokens were given as praise rewards
  • 7% distributed among quantifiers
  • 3% assigned to the reward board

This data has been reviewed by the Quantifiers and the Reward Board, and has been submitted for distribution to the Reward Board DAO

You can check out the full period analysis here.

This post will be open to the community for review for 48 hours then submitted to the Reward Board for final execution.
